translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: 1 Korint Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Korint

content: Nǝsa evi tarhǝt silat siYesu?
Na-lǝmas-buni-an m̃au tiwol hǝn nǝmauran samito, ale mǝtelǝŋon masuṽ hǝn natit gail lotogǝm len aNunun aGot. Be a mǝhat len natgalen, mǝtelǝŋon masuṽ hǝn mǝtb̃ikel napisulan siGot.
Husur nǝvanuan tosor len nasoruan tiltile gail, sasor mai nǝvanuan gail, be isor mai aGot ŋai, husur avan ideh sasǝsǝloŋ lǝboii. Len aNunun aGot, avan enan ikel natetǝtan gail.
Be nǝvanuan tokel ur nǝsa aGot tokel maii, nakelean san igol nǝvanuan gail ludaŋ am len nǝmauran salito, igol lolǝŋon ivoi am len nǝlolito, mai etǝŋov nǝlolit vi pan.
Nǝvanuan tosor len nasoruan tiltile gail evi tarhǝt san gabag, be nǝvanuan tokel ur nǝsa aGot tokel maii, gai igol alat siYesu p̃isi ludaŋ am len nǝmauran salito.

Nolǝŋon ke gamit p̃isi mǝtolǝboi mǝtb̃isor len nasoruan tiltile gail, be nolǝŋon masuṽ sǝhori am hǝn mǝtb̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokele. Nǝvanuan tokel ur nǝsa aGot tokel maii, evi tarhǝt silat siYesu sǝhor nǝvanuan tosor len nasoruan tiltile gail. Be egaii b̃ikel ur namilen nasoruan tiltile galenan hǝn alat siYesu lǝb̃elǝboii sǝhoti, igol galit ludaŋ am len nǝmauran salito.

Be bathudud nadǝlomian, nǝtagǝm hǝn gamit, nǝtasor len nasoruan tiltile gail, tavi tarhǝt samit mabe? Be nǝb̃ikel na-kel-vǝhoti-an seNunun aGot mai gamito, nǝb̃ikel nalǝboian, nǝb̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokel mai ginau, nǝb̃ikel nap̃usanan seNunun aGot, natgalen p̃isi lovi tarhǝt samito.
Mitinau nab̃uvimal mai navus beltaŋ; arsǝmaur be arugol nǝwalan. Asike datb̃iram̃ram̃e hǝn gǝlar b̃inor, avan ideh telǝboi mab hǝn nǝb̃e dattoram̃ram̃e hǝni?
Mitinau nǝtrampet; ale nǝvanuan b̃evuv suluṽi, nasoltia telǝboi mab hǝni ke timasutaut hǝn gai m̃os nab̃iltib̃alan?
Imaienan hǝn gamito. Mǝtb̃isor len nasoruan nǝvanuan lototǝtan hǝni, lelǝboi namilen nasoruan samit mabe? Mǝtb̃isor maienan, ehum mǝttosor kǝmas len namǝsav ŋai.
Len navile a pan nǝvanuan lusor len nasoruan tiltile isob̃ur, ale gail p̃isi lukad namilelito.
Imagenan, avan ideh b̃isor mai ginau, asike nǝb̃elǝboi namilen nasoran san, len nabunusian sagw, gai tosor evi metb̃os, ale len nabunusian san, ginau novi metb̃os.
Imaienan hǝn gamito. Husur ke mǝttolǝŋon masuṽ hǝn natit gail seNunun aGot, mitimashisi hǝn mǝtb̃idaŋ am len natit gail seNunun aGot lotogol alat siYesu lǝb̃idaŋ am len nǝmauran salito.
Imagenan, avan ideh tosor len nasoruan tile ideh, teus aGot hǝn nǝdaŋan hǝn b̃ikel ur namilen natetǝtan gai tokele.
Husur nǝb̃isor tuṽ len nasoruan tile ideh, len aNunun aGot, nanunugw totoh len nǝlogw isor tuṽ, be nǝnauan sagw ipat kǝmas ŋai.

Nigol nǝsa beti? Len aNunun aGot dereh nanunugw tisor tuṽ. Ale dereh nisor tuṽ am hǝn nǝvanuan lǝb̃elǝboi sǝhot na-sor-tuṽ-an sagw. Len aNunun aGot dereh nanunugw tekǝkai. Ale dereh nekǝkai am hǝn nǝvanuan lǝb̃elǝboi sǝhot nǝsa notokǝkai hǝni.

Asike b̃imagenan, dereh timaiegai ke: len aNunun aGot, nanunum̃ totoh len nǝlom̃ b̃isor len nasoruan tile hǝn gǝb̃isal suh aGot, nǝvanuan totǝtan hǝni, salǝboi b̃ike “Ganan” hǝn nasipaan sam̃, husur gai salǝboi nǝsa gotokele.
Naut kǝmas nasipaan sam̃ b̃ivoi, asike igol avan enan idaŋ am len nǝmauran san.
Nosipa vi tǝban aGot hǝn notosor len nasoruan tiltile gail sǝhor gamit p̃isi mǝttogole.

Be len nab̃onb̃onan silat siYesu, len nalǝboian sagw, nǝb̃isor b̃em̃idol ŋai len nasoruan lotolǝboii, hǝn lǝb̃esǝsǝloŋ sǝhot nap̃usanan sagw, ivoi masuṽ sǝhor nǝb̃isor b̃ebǝlav len nasoruan tile lototǝtan hǝni.
Bathudud nadǝlomian, samtesum̃an alahutai len nǝnauan samito. Mǝtesum̃an atuhlahutai lǝsalǝboi naṽide hǝn nǝsaan sal, be len nabunusian samito, len nǝnauan samito, mǝtesum̃an nǝvanuan tomatmatu.
Len nalo lutosi ke, Nasub̃ aGot ekǝmaiegai:

content.text: “Len nǝvanuan lotosor len nasoruan tiltile gail,

content: Imagenan beti, hum ma mǝttonau suluṽi ke nasoruan tiltile gail igol p̃arp̃ar hǝni ke aGot itoh mai alat lotokad nadǝlomian lan. Be nasoruan tiltile galenan lǝsǝpat m̃os alat lotokad nadǝlomian, be hǝn alat lǝsǝkad nadǝlomian lǝb̃ipes hab̃etw lan. Avil na-kel-uri-an hǝn nǝsa aGot tokele, igol p̃arp̃ar hǝni ke aGot itoh mai alat lotokad nadǝlomian lan. Ipat m̃os alat lotokad nadǝlomian, savi m̃os alat lǝsǝkad nadǝlomian.
Imaienan, gamit siYesu p̃isi mǝtb̃ib̃onb̃on, gamit p̃isi mǝtb̃isor len nasoruan tiltile gail, ale nǝvanuan galevis am lototǝtan hǝn nadǝlomian o lǝsǝkade, lǝb̃eb̃is lohoim, dereh like mǝttovinvinu.
Be gamit p̃isi mǝtb̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokel mai gamito, ale avan ideh totǝtan hǝn nadǝlomian o sǝkade b̃eb̃is lohoim, len natgalen p̃isi, dereh nǝlon timab̃ur, telǝboi sǝhot nǝsaan san tosob̃ur,
ale natit lotosusuah len nǝlon lip̃arp̃ar. Ale dereh tipair dan nǝsaan san, titeh len tan, kǝta vi pan hǝn b̃ilotu hǝn aGot. Dereh tisor tǝvah ke, “Ekitin, aGot itoh len gamito.”
Nap̃isal hǝn nab̃onb̃onan hǝn nalotuan

Bathudud nadǝlomian, nekǝmabe? Nimaris kotov nǝsa notokele maiegai. Nǝboŋ mǝtb̃ib̃onb̃on hǝn mǝtb̃ilotu, gamit ideh tekǝkai, gamit ideh tep̃usan, gamit ideh tikel na-kel-vǝhoti-an seNunun aGot, gamit ideh tikel nasoruan len nasoruan tile, ideh am tikel namilen. Natit p̃isi mǝtb̃igole limasgol gamit p̃isi siYesu mǝtb̃idaŋ am len nǝmauran samito.
Gamit ideh b̃elǝŋon b̃ikel nasoruan len nasoruan tile, teru o titor ŋai lisor, salesǝhor totor. Limassor ṽisusua ale avan ideh timaskel namilen nasoruan salito.
Asike mǝtb̃ikad avan ideh tolǝboi b̃ikel namilen, nǝvanuan toke tikel nasoruan len nasoruan tile, satisor len nab̃onb̃onan. Tisor mai gai gabag mai aGot ŋai.
Gamit ideh b̃elǝŋon b̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokel maii, teru o titor lisor, ale galit am limassǝsǝloŋ, nau vahvahur na-kel-uri-an enan, hǝn lǝb̃elǝboi sǝhoti ke togǝm len aNunun aGot o eb̃uer.
Ale avan ideh am tobǝtah, na-kel-vǝhoti-an seNunun aGot b̃egǝm hǝni, nǝvanuan tosor tesib hǝn tobǝtah b̃isor.
Len naṽide tomagenan, galit p̃isi lǝb̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokel mai galito, lisor ṽisusua hǝn gamit p̃isi mǝtb̃elǝboi sǝhot nap̃usanan, ale hǝn gamit p̃isi mǝtb̃elǝŋon b̃ivoi am len nǝlomito.
Mitinau gat nategai: nǝvanuan tokel ur nǝsa aGot tokel maii, iwol hǝn nanunun totoh len nǝlon, gol ke tolǝboi b̃isor o b̃esib len nasoran san hǝn avan ideh am b̃isor.

Len nalotuan, aGot emǝtahun gamit p̃isi mǝtb̃isor taṽtaṽor b̃onb̃on len namityal tosua ŋai. AGot savi aGot hǝn nǝtaṽtaṽoran, ao, evi aGot hǝn natǝm̃at. Timagenan len nab̃onb̃onan silat siYesu len naut p̃isi.
Len nab̃onb̃onan gail silat siYesu latpǝhaṽut lemǝdau husur sanor hǝn lǝb̃isor, be litoh mǝdau, sǝsǝloŋ husur nalotuan, hum nalo tokele.
Lǝb̃elǝŋon ke lǝb̃elǝboi sǝhot natideh, leus asoalit a im sǝb̃olito. Evi hur sasa hǝn napǝhaṽut b̃isor len nab̃onb̃onan silat siYesu.
Mǝtunau ke gamit mǝtovi nǝkadun nasoruan siGot a? Mǝtunau ke ibar gamit sǝb̃omito ŋa?
Gamit ideh b̃inau ke tovi ahai kelkel ur o nǝvanuan aNunun aGot totoh lan, telǝboi sǝhoti, ke, nǝsa nototosi van hǝn gamit gagai evi nakelean todaŋ siNasub̃.
Be avan ideh b̃emǝtahun b̃elǝboi natenan, aGot dereh temǝtahun b̃elǝboi avan enan.
Imagenan bathudud sagw len nadǝlomian, mǝtelǝŋon masuṽ hǝn mǝtb̃ikel napisulan siGot, ale samtikai tas nasoran len nasoruan tiltile gail.
Be len nab̃onb̃onan, mitigol natit p̃isi len naṽide tovoi, mǝtehusur nǝyah hǝn nalotuan notomadhakele, samtilotu b̃ular.

footnotes.text: 14.21 Isa 28.11-12. Nǝboŋ aIsaiah totos nasoruan siGot toke, alategai, aGot isor husur nǝvanuan san gail a Jutah.

14.35 Nǝvanuan namitisau galevis hǝn nasoruan siGot lunau ke naves 34-35 savi natosian kitin siPol. Len natosian galevis ta sutuai, naves 34-35 arupat len naut egai, len natosian galevis am arupat a tahw, husur 14.40.
